reasons: Both answers reach the same well-reasoned recommendation: Postgres with pg_trgm, a normalized part-number column, live stock and price joins, a transactional check at checkout, and a timeboxed spike with pass/fail gates. B is more actionable because it gives concrete DDL (a generated pn_norm column, trigram and weighted tsvector indexes), a query strategy, and a correct trigram similarity calculation for 'bering'. B also covers an extra failure mode, search load competing with OLTP (read replica, statement_timeout), and gives both engineers a role in the spike.
